shipped_rows.title_o: Development and preliminary validation of the young adult alcohol consequences questionnaire.

blind_target.evidence_quote: A preliminary psychometric evaluation in a U.S. college sample showed support for 8 factors that were invariant across gender and that loaded onto a single higher-order alcohol-related problems factor.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Our study provides an important replication of the psychometrics of the YAACQ in a new sample, and we extend previous work by presenting novel tests of measurement invariance across meaningful groups in young adulthood.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly describe their study as a replication of the psychometrics. The abstract does not give the original citation or reference list.
